defs.def: any of the hard parts that form the skeleton of the body of a human or an animal 骨头；骨

ex.s: New inventions like 3D printers have been used to make replacement hearts and bone parts.
ex.t: 像3D打印机这样的新发明已被用来制造用于替换的心脏和骨骼部件。

ex.s: In China during the Shang Dynasty, people recorded weather forecasts on animal bones and tortoise shells.
ex.t: 中国商朝时期，人们把天气预报刻写在兽骨和龟甲上。

ex.s: Imagine bone-white coral 6,000 metres below the ocean’s surface, growing at the rate of only one or two millimetres per year.
ex.t: 想象一下海面下6000米处骨白色的珊瑚，它们每年仅以一两毫米的速度生长。

ex.s: It also helps build strong leg bones.
ex.t: 它还有助于增强腿部骨骼。

ex.s: With no gravity to push against, astronauts’ bones and muscles can become weak.
ex.t: 没有重力可以对抗，宇航员的骨骼和肌肉会变得虚弱。

defs.def: the hard substance that bones are made of 骨质

ex.s: Mike Curtin sees my arugula story all the time — but for him, it's more like 12 bones of donated strawberries nearing their last days.
ex.t: Mike Curtin总是看到我的芝麻菜故事——但对他来说，那更像12盒快过期的捐赠草莓。

defs.def: having bones of the type mentioned 构成形容词
